description: §19.16.5 — a SERVER-tier deferred body (its own `?{}` SQL) in a function the compiler body-splits is E-DEFER-SERVER-IN-SPLIT, exactly once: it would have to run inside a server batch, which ends before the later continuations — the premature release §19.16.5 forbids. Rejected rather than lowered wrongly.
rationale: §19.16.5: a deferred body that is itself server-tier in a function that the compiler splits SHALL be a compile error (E-DEFER-SERVER-IN-SPLIT).
